claims.statement: The tutorial index spans FPT/GHES/GHEC and links personalization and resume enhancement; the latter is FPT-only. Parent versions do not expand the child's scope or authorize hands-on mutations.

The tutorial says profile name is required but all other described information optional, and the name need not match real-world identity. Broad self-service Name editing must be reconciled with managed-enterprise IdP-only display-name control; this is not permission to invent personal records.

Photo upload uses Settings, Edit, Upload, crop and Set new profile picture; reset Remove photo returns to identicon unless email-associated Gravatar requires Revert to Gravatar. The generic Gravatar reset caveat must preserve managed-user Gravatar exclusion in the reference. No image upload or third-party linkage is performed.

Bio is limited to 160 characters; member organizations autocomplete in mentions, while nonmember organizations may still be mentioned without autocomplete. An organization mention is not membership or employment evidence.

Pronouns and up-to-four social links are gated to FPT/GHEC by their datasets. Custom pronouns and full social URLs are optional disclosure; example account URLs are not adopted identities and profile Update does not prove observer-visible behavior.
Location may be entered and current local time optionally shown using a timezone selection. These fields are personal disclosure, not authenticated location or authorization for work-hours decisions.

Cloud ORCID connection requires signing into the external ORCID account and returning to GitHub. Researcher linkage is an optional identity operation requiring owner authorization, not proof of publication ownership or authority to supply credentials.

Status supports message, emoji, optional Busy, expiration and audience. Without expiration it persists until edited/cleared; without organization selection it is public. Busy can affect automatic review assignment per the reference, so status is not purely cosmetic.

External emoji/Markdown cheat sheets and linked concept/reference/how-to pages are pointers, not automatically imported source corpora or executable instructions. No profile disclosure, account link or setting changes are made.

The resume tutorial is FPT-only and gives job-search recommendations and optimistic hiring outcomes, not an engineering compliance mandate, measured interview improvement or required personal disclosure.

Suggested bio, optional photo/portfolio/social links and profile README may describe introduction, skills, experience, projects and awards. Every personal claim must be truthful and owner-approved; example Mona/new2code identities are not deployable placeholders and private employer material needs clearance.

Selecting three to five relevant projects is a presentation recommendation, not the six-item combined technical pin limit or an obligation to publish private work. Owned and contributed projects demonstrate different scope; contribution does not grant mutation control.

Helpful project READMEs describe features, setup/run, examples/demo and tests. Copilot prompting and copying edited output are recommendations, not executed generation or evidence that commands, claims and examples are valid; generated text needs project-specific verification.
Repository description, website and topics help understanding but are metadata writes requiring target authorization and truthful links. A demo link is not verified deployment or availability.

Consistent style, descriptive names, complex-code comments, appropriate style guides, simplification and tests are recommended readability practices. Copilot/VS Code setup and external example scripts are pointers, not installation/execution authority or proof tests cover behavior.

The advice to use latest dependencies and Dependabot PRs must be generalized to reviewed secure, compatible versions with tests and approved merges. Latest alone is not proven safe; an update PR is not deployment, and enabling automation is an approved write with credentials/cost implications.

Sharing the profile/resume or posting in the linked public Community discussion is optional publication requiring user authority. Tutorial confidence about job-search impact is not measured acceptance; no message, public profile change or dependency update occurs here.
